app.tour.alerts.text.text: {alerts} tells you about likes, comments, friend requests and your device. In {settings} you change your profile, password and photo backup.
app.tour.alerts.text.note: Text of the tour's page about the Alerts and Settings sections. {alerts} is the Alerts section's name (app.shell.section_alerts) and {settings} the Settings section's name (app.shell.section_settings), both in bold (…).

app.tour.alerts.title.note: Title of the tour's page about the Alerts and Settings sections: use the same words as their names (app.shell.section_alerts, app.shell.section_settings).

app.tour.backup.text.text: This phone can copy its photos and videos to your device by itself. Choose what it sends in {settings} › {sync}.
app.tour.backup.text.note: Text of the tour's page about the photo backup. {settings} is the Settings section's name (app.shell.section_settings) and {sync} the heading of its section with the photo sync's options (app.settings.sync.title), both in bold (…); › joins them as a path, Settings first.

app.tour.backup.title.note: Title of the tour's page about this phone copying its own photos and videos to the device (the photo backup).

app.tour.collections.text.text: Keep photos that belong together in one place, like a trip or a birthday. Press and hold photos in Images to select them, then tap {add}.
app.tour.collections.text.note: Text of the tour's Collections page (its title is app.shell.section_collections): collections are our word for named groups of photos - never say album. Images is the photo section (app.shell.section_images). {add} is the selection bar's item that puts the selected photos in a collection (app.shell.add_to_collection), in bold (…).

app.tour.collections.where.text: Your collections open with this button, next to the search in Images.
app.tour.collections.where.note: Under the text of the tour's Collections page on a phone held upright: the page's picture is the button at the right of the search field at the top of Images (app.shell.section_images) that opens the collections.

app.tour.collections.where_wide.text: Your collections are in the menu.
app.tour.collections.where_wide.note: Under the text of the tour's Collections page on a wide screen (a phone on its side, a tablet), where Collections is an item of the left menu.

app.tour.done.text.text: See this tour again any time: tap {show} in {settings}.
app.tour.done.text.note: Text of the tour's last page. {show} is the button in Settings that shows the tour again (app.tour.show) and {settings} the Settings section's name (app.shell.section_settings), both in bold (…).

app.tour.done.title.note: Title of the tour's last page.

app.tour.files.text.text: Your documents and folders, kept on your device. Tap {upload} at the bottom to add files from this phone, and tap a file to open it.
app.tour.files.text.note: Text of the tour's Files page (its title is app.shell.section_files). {upload} is the Upload button in the bar at the bottom of Files (common.upload), in bold (…).

app.tour.friends.accept.text: A request sent to you waits under {waiting}: tap {accept}.
app.tour.friends.accept.note: Second line of the tour's Friends page: answering a friend request. {waiting} is the heading of the Friends screen's section with the requests you received (app.social.friends.waiting_answer) and {accept} the button that accepts one (common.accept), both in bold (…).

app.tour.friends.add.text: To add a friend, type their device's name, the part before .{suffix}, under {heading} and tap {send}.
app.tour.friends.add.note: First line of the tour's Friends page (its title is app.shell.section_friends): sending a friend request. {suffix} is the fixed end of every device's address, off-the.cloud, written after the dot. {heading} is the heading of the Friends screen's section for it (app.social.friends.add_heading) and {send} its button (common.send), both in bold (…).

app.tour.friends.where.text: Friends opens with the two-people button at the top of Social.
app.tour.friends.where.note: Under the lines of the tour's Friends page on a phone held upright: Friends (app.shell.section_friends) opens with the button showing two people at the top of the Social feed (app.shell.section_social).

app.tour.friends.where_wide.note: Under the lines of the tour's Friends page on a wide screen (a phone on its side, a tablet), where Friends is an item of the left menu.

app.tour.images.text.text: All your photos and videos, newest first. Search at the top for places and things in your photos.
app.tour.images.text.note: Text of the tour's page about Images, the library of photos and videos (its title is app.shell.section_images). The search field is at the top of the screen: it finds places (from where the photos were taken) and things seen in them.

app.tour.people.text.text: The faces found in your photos, one person each. Tap {name} to name someone, and tap a face to see all their photos.
app.tour.people.text.note: Text of the tour's People page (its title is app.shell.section_people): the people face recognition found, one face per person. {name} is the tappable line under a face that has no name (app.photos.people.add_name), in bold (…).

app.tour.people.where.text: Open People with this button, next to the search in Images.
app.tour.people.where.note: Under the text of the tour's People page on a phone held upright: the page's picture is the button at the right of the search field at the top of Images (app.shell.section_images) that opens People.

app.tour.people.where_wide.note: Under the text of the tour's People page on a wide screen (a phone on its side, a tablet), where People is an item of the left menu.

app.tour.post.step1.text: In Social, tap + at the top.
app.tour.post.step1.note: First numbered step of the tour's page about publishing a post: the plus button at the top of the Social section (app.shell.section_social), in bold (…). Keep the + as it is.

app.tour.post.step2.text: Pick photos or videos from {phone} (this phone) or {synced} (already on your device).
app.tour.post.step2.note: Second numbered step of the tour's page about publishing a post: the switch at the top of the New Post composer. {phone} and {synced} are its two halves (app.social.compose.source_phone, app.social.compose.source_synced), in bold (…).

app.tour.post.step3.note: Third numbered step of the tour's page about publishing a post: a post needs a caption (the box at the foot of the composer). {publish} is the composer's button (app.social.compose.publish), in bold (…).

app.tour.post.title.note: Title of the tour's page about publishing a post on Social; numbered steps follow (app.tour.post.step1 to step3).

app.tour.progress.note: At the top of each page of the tour: {step} is the page's number and {total} how many pages the tour has (10 or 11). Also read out by screen readers.

app.tour.settings.footer.text: A short tour of the app: your photos, posting to Social, friends and where everything is.
app.tour.settings.footer.note: Under the Show the tour button (app.tour.show) in Settings: what the tour covers. Social is the feed section (app.shell.section_social).

app.tour.settings.title.note: Heading of the section of Settings with the button that shows the app's tour again (app.tour.show).

app.tour.show.note: Button in Settings, in the section app.tour.settings.title: shows the app's tour again from its first page.

app.tour.skip.note: Button at the top of every page of the tour: closes it. The tour can be shown again from Settings.

app.tour.social.text.text: Your private feed with family and friends: like posts with the heart and comment on them. Your posts go from your device to your friends' devices, and only your friends see them.
app.tour.social.text.note: Text of the tour's Social page (its title is app.shell.section_social): the feed of posts shared with friends. The heart is the like button under each post; the comment box is under it too.

app.tour.welcome.text.text: Your photos and files live on your own device, at home. Share them with family and friends in a private network of your own.
app.tour.welcome.text.note: Text of the tour's first page: what Off The Cloud is. The device is the small computer at home that keeps everything.

app.tour.welcome.title.note: Title of the tour's first page. The tour is shown once after signing in to a device, and again from Settings.
